name: VASE
source:
One broken vase. One unexpected death. Tremaine wakes as a ghost in Stone Manor, a place where walls shift, rooms vanish, and magic bends reality.

With only a frantic witch and a few grim mana gems to guide her, she must navigate the impossible to recover her body.

Every step could be her last – or worse, she might never return to life.

[From [url=https://pepperparker.itch.io/vase]Itch.io[/url]]
